decision: MIXED_COST_ESTABLISHED_PREVALENCE_UNEVALUABLE_CROSSSITE_HELD_AT_HYPOTHESIS_NO_PROMOTION: the measurement transaction completed validly and credential-free (result.json status=COMPLETE, outcome=MIXED; audit.json status=REVISE, producer_claim_supported=true), and it settles exactly one of the two halves the mandate asked for. COST HALF ESTABLISHED at the audited ceiling: a minimal HTTP+HTML structural representation costs 763.06 tokens / 2,801.19 bytes per observation (mean; median 576 / 2,138) over n=155 observations from 15 eTLD+1 hosts, against B-RAW-HTML 52,020.35 / 151,741.41, B-FULL-DOM 50,907.34 / 145,140.82 and the preregistered B-A11Y-TREE approximation 16,793.67 / 48,693.05, all four on the same 155 observations under one shared tokenizer (cl100k_base, n_vocab 100277); ratios 68.2x / 66.7x / 22.0x in tokens, with paired eTLD+1-level bootstrap (10,000 replicates) 95% CI upper bounds of -22,823.81 tokens vs full DOM and -8,932.25 tokens vs a11y, both strictly negative, and minimal smaller on 155/155 and 150/155 observations respectively. The frozen cost clause is SATISFIED (audit baseline_findings[0..3], recomputed_metrics.cost_per_observation_mean and cost_paired_differences). PREVALENCE HALF NOT ESTABLISHED AND NOT FALSIFIED: the frozen primary clause is UNEVALUABLE because the frozen estimator and its frozen null are the same object up to a label. AGF = sum_K (T_K^2 - sum_s n_{s,K}^2)/(2*total_signatures) depends on the per-host key counts only through the symmetric quantity sum_s n_{s,K}^2, so permuting eTLD+1 labels is exactly invariant: 1,000 permutations produced exactly 1 distinct value, bitwise equal to the observed point estimate 83.51083467094703, std = 0.0 exactly, and the clause reduces to 83.51083467094703 > 83.51083467094703. result.json records primary_evaluable=false and primary_satisfied=null, NOT false, and the auditor confirms this (audit required_fixes[0], validity_findings[0]-[1]). This is a defect in the frozen estimator/null pair, not infrastructure failure and not a scientific negative: no substrate was missing, 0 of 155 pages failed extraction, and 0 credentials, registry pulls, browser binaries or model API calls were used (audit validity_findings[2]). C-CROSSSITE therefore stays at HYPOTHESIS. The frozen design's own consequence (prereg.md section 18) ties the HYPOTHESIS->EXPERIMENTAL move to 'measured prevalence AND cost floor'; only cost was measured, and the registry construct is mechanism transfer across a website holdout (next_gate 'true website holdout without site identity leakage'), which this packet did not measure, so promoting the claim would be status inflation. audit.json status is REVISE, not PASS, so VALIDATED is unavailable in any case, and lane=intel forecloses PRODUCT_CORE. No product action, no promotion, continue=false. The one genuinely decision-relevant prevalence datum is NOT the AGF magnitude but the audit's decomposition: only 67 distinct signature keys are shared by >=2 of the 15 hosts, list signatures are 97.25% of all 416,218 matched instances, a single key list(ul, /{slug}/{slug}) is 49.56% of them, 96.49% come from keys carried by 6+ hosts, and only 3.51% from the site-pair-specific 2-5-host regime a cross-site inheritance product would monetise; the audit's own words are that the frozen AGF 'primarily measures that the Web is built from <ul> elements, not that it contains reusable task structure'. Under the only non-frozen null with power (NC-SIG-REASSIGN, 869 distinct values, std 0.193) the observed sharing sits 18.58 AGF units and 0.2507 Jaccard units BELOW a random re-partition of the same template vocabulary. That is evidence against the specific mechanism this statistic can see; it is explicitly NOT a bounded negative on C-CROSSSITE, because the statistic cannot separate reusable task structure from shared HTML boilerplate, and the auditor reserved independent confirmation of that producer-constructed randomisation before any lane re-scopes on its direction (audit unresolved[3]). Five of twenty pre-registered hosts are recorded NOT_MEASURED with exact blocking artefacts per portfolio directive G1, and are neither negatives nor evidence about those sites.

MEASUREMENT_INVALID is explicitly NOT applied: the transaction was validly completed with no infrastructure or substrate failure (audit validity_findings[2]), and encoding a frozen-estimator defect as a validity gate is the gate-proliferation failure this packet's own director_mandate portfolio_assessment names. The registry next_gate is untouched by this packet and C-CROSSSITE still has no external numeric comparator: the audit records that no external baseline bar was produced for prevalence (audit unresolved[5]).

UNCHANGED at EXPERIMENTAL (research/claims/registry.json C-MEAS-VALID status=EXPERIMENTAL, owner_lanes runtime+physics; Intel is not an owner lane and this event records an audited instance, it does not direct owner action). Recorded because this packet is a clean, reusable, first-class instance of the exact failure class the director_mandate portfolio_assessment enumerates as mechanism (3), 'estimators and endpoints that cannot see their own failure mode', and it is the third documented instance in the program. FOUR CONCRETE, PORTABLE DEFECTS, each with its exact evidence. (1) NON-IDENTIFYING NULL: a statistic invariant to the very permutation its null applies. AGF = sum_K (T_K^2 - sum_s n_{s,K}^2)/(2*total_signatures) is symmetric in the host index, so eTLD+1 label permutation is exactly invariant; 1 distinct value over 1,000 permutations, std 0.0, p95 == point estimate bitwise, and mean pairwise Jaccard likewise took 1 distinct value. The frozen validity sub-condition null_std>0 then fails by algebraic necessity, so the gate that was supposed to catch it could only ever fail, never pass (audit required_fixes[0], validity_findings[0]-[1]). (2) UNREACHABLE POSITIVE-CONTROL THRESHOLD: prereg 11.2 expected AGF>0.8 from a 2-host design, but under the frozen 7.3 definition a 2-host design caps at exactly 0.5 (n signatures per host, keys distinct and matched 1:1 gives matched=n, total=2n), so the frozen control could not have passed whatever the fixture contained; observed 0.5833 exceeds 0.5 only because 2 of 14 matched instances come from duplicated keys (audit required_fixes[1]). (3) MISLABELLED MEASUREMENT UNIT: the frozen metric is unbounded above - one signature can match on every host pair - so 83.51 is not a fraction in [0,1] despite prereg 7.3 calling it one and cannot be compared to any external prevalence number; a headline number that looks like a fraction and is not is a standing validity hazard (audit required_fixes[6]). (4) A HEURISTIC THAT INFLATES EVERY POPULATION: any single-segment path templates to /{slug}, so structurally unlike sites can share a template, and 66.13% of signatures carry at least one typed slot; this biases observed and null populations alike and was never quantified (audit required_fixes[7]). NOTE WHAT DID NOT FAIL, so the lesson is not over-read: the measurement substrate itself was sound - 0 of 155 extraction failures, 177 credential-free requests, byte-identical reruns, and the frozen estimator independently reproduced by brute force over all 105 host pairs (audit validity_findings[2],[5]) - and the pipeline's sensitivity WAS demonstrated, but only against a non-frozen producer-constructed null (audit validity_findings[4]; result.json controls.PC-SYNTHETIC-ALIAS pass_basis). So the recorded instance is: a valid substrate can still host a non-identifying design, and the correct response is to fix the statistic, not to add a prerequisite. The registry next_gate ('writable/auth/session/drift controls must produce discriminating positive and null outcomes') is untouched and remains the owner's.

next_question: Does any published system or benchmark report a CROSS-SITE TRANSFER result - mechanisms learned on one set of real websites and then executed on a held-out set of never-seen websites - as four separately measurable quantities on a stated denominator (transfer success on a stated N of held-out sites, execution correctness conditional on resolution, abstention-or-refusal rate, and either a stated boilerplate-exclusion rule or an explicit split of task/actionable structure from shared HTML template boilerplate), together with its holdout rule (leave-one-site-out or equivalent, no site-identity leakage) and its denominators; and specifically, does any such report isolate the site-pair-specific stratum from the ubiquitous-template stratum? FALSIFIER: no source publishes a cross-site transfer rate in that four-part form with a stated holdout split, in which case C-CROSSSITE has NO external numeric comparator, the registry next_gate 'true website holdout without site identity leakage' must be set internally, and the external-bar question is closed in the negative FOR THAT CORPUS ONLY, with bounded recall over the mandate's target list recorded exactly. A negative is worth having only if the search can actually fail, so the design must carry the fixes this cycle and its predecessor exposed rather than repeating a self-fulfilling null: (i) resolve every target name to a verified artifact identity BEFORE scoring any condition, and record 'not located' as UNMEASURED and never as a system-level negative - that single omission is exactly how the predecessor's mandated target COVENANT, 1 of 5, was silently substituted by arXiv:2608.02680 and lost; (ii) include a null control with power against the failure that actually occurred, i.e. inject a deliberately wrong artifact identity or a deliberately shared-boilerplate corpus and require the pipeline to flag it, since the predecessor's NC-FABRICATED-BINDING-CLAIMS searched for three literal phrases no paper would contain and detected nothing while a target identity was being substituted underneath it; (iii) require every reported number to carry its accounting convention, its denominator and its holdout rule, so that a corpus figure cannot be mistaken for a rate. CONTINGENCY IF NEGATIVE, recorded here as routing rather than as a second question: C-CROSSSITE's internal bar must then be set by a statistic that is NOT invariant to host relabelling paired with a null built on a permutation that IS - the frozen AGF here is provably invariant under eTLD+1 relabelling, 1 distinct value over 1,000 permutations bitwise equal to the point estimate - and that statistic must partition shared HTML template boilerplate from site-pair-specific task structure, because on this packet's 155 pages 97.25% of matched instances were list signatures and only 3.51% came from the site-pair-specific 2-5-host regime a cross-site inheritance product would monetise. That internal work belongs to C-CROSSSITE's owner lanes (physics, graph, frontier), not to Intel.
reason: Adjudicated against the frozen design, the producer handoff and the independent audit, with all five frozen input digests, all five audit-referenced artifact digests and the request.json parent_handoff digest recomputed and matched at this stage. The transaction was real and the substrate was sound: credential-free public HTTP only (0 credentials, 0 registry pulls, 0 browser binaries, 0 model API calls), 177 requests to 23 hosts, 155 pages retained from 15 of 20 pre-registered hosts, 0 of 155 extraction failures, a 37-second fetch window at a 1.05 s per-host minimum interval, byte-identical reruns of the analysis, and the frozen AGF plus mean pairwise Jaccard independently reproduced by brute force over all 105 host pairs (matched 416218, total 4984, AGF 83.510834670947, mean Jaccard 0.126721042325). The audit corroborates this and goes further, confirming the null degeneracy algebraically as well as empirically. THE DECISION IS SPLIT ALONG THE TWO HALVES THE MANDATE ASKED FOR, and neither half is allowed to speak for the other. Cost: a valid, strongly satisfied, audited measurement with every convention attached, which I record as established and route to the shared per-span cost ledger with its denominators. Prevalence: unevaluable, because the frozen estimator and the frozen null are the same function of the data up to a relabelling, so the frozen clause is x>x. I decline the three tempting wrong answers. I do not read primary_satisfied=null as false, because that would convert a design defect into a scientific negative on a claim the packet never tested. I do not read MIXED as partial support for prevalence, which result.json's own decision_rule_evaluation.clause_interpretation forbids. I do not read the powered-null direction and the 97.25%-list-boilerplate decomposition as retirement of the cross-site market thesis, because the statistic cannot tell reusable task structure from boilerplate and the auditor says so in terms; the market thesis is untouched, at HYPOTHESIS, and the genuinely new prevalence datum is that the one stratum a cross-site inheritance product would monetise is 3.51% of measured matching on this sample. I also decline the opposite error of over-crediting: the frozen positive control's stated purpose is confirmed but its numeric threshold is arithmetically unreachable on a 2-host design, and the only null with power is producer-constructed, non-frozen and explicitly decision-not-used, so it is recorded as a direction requiring independent confirmation and not as a result. I do not promote C-CROSSSITE, because prereg section 18 ties that move to measured prevalence AND cost, because the registry construct is mechanism transfer across a website holdout which was not measured, and because audit status REVISE forecloses VALIDATED; I equally do not demote it, because this packet's finding is a frozen-estimator defect rather than evidence against the claim, and marking it REJECTED or MEASUREMENT_INVALID would be the environmental-absence-as-validity-gate error the mandate's own portfolio assessment warns against. continue=false because the next step is a new statistic on a new sample, which is a NEW experiment requiring a Global Research Director mandate rather than an immediate chain, and because the thread's remaining prevalence work sits with C-CROSSSITE's owner lanes (physics, graph, frontier).
